title: Contribution Contract Intents
description: Canonical schema for intents.yaml. Enforced by Event.Architecture.Tests.AgentContextIntentManifestTests. Do not relax required fields without updating the matching test.

version.description: Schema major version. Bumped only when backward-incompatible changes are made.

category.description: Broad grouping. Restricted enum so routing/reporting stays predictable.

triggers.description: Phrase patterns used to classify an incoming request to this intent.

must_read_docs.description: Repo-relative paths. AgentContextLinkTests verifies each exists.

load_rules.description: Rule file paths under .claude/rules/. AgentContextLinkTests verifies each exists.

paths_in_scope.description: Glob allow-list of files the agent may modify for this intent.

paths_forbidden.description: Glob deny-list. Takes precedence over paths_in_scope when a file matches both.

minimum_tests.description: Test project names (e.g. Event.API.IntegrationTests). AgentContextIntentManifestTests verifies each project exists.

docs_to_update.description: Docs that SHOULD be updated in the same PR if the intent causes user-visible changes.

pr_checklist.description: Concrete, verifiable PR checklist items specific to this intent.

forbidden_without_approval.description: Actions that require explicit user approval. If the change requires one of these, stop and ask.

related_agents.description: Agents under .claude/agents/ that may be invoked for this intent.

related_intents.description: Cross-references to sibling intents by id.

verification_commands.description: Shell commands the agent must run before declaring the change complete.
